scripts.web: npm run build -w @recipe-manager/shared && npm run clean:vite -w @recipe-manager/web && npm run start -w @recipe-manager/web
scripts.api: npm run build -w @recipe-manager/shared && npm run start:dev -w @recipe-manager/api
scripts.prisma:seed: npm run build -w @recipe-manager/shared && npm run prisma:seed -w @recipe-manager/api
scripts.db:sync-tags: npm run build -w @recipe-manager/shared && node apps/api/prisma/seeds/assign-recipe-tags.mjs && npm run prisma:seed
scripts.build: npm run build -w @recipe-manager/shared && npm run build -w @recipe-manager/api && npm run build -w @recipe-manager/web
